content:
keith: Hey team — we've got intermittent 502s when clients open streaming connections through our customer's Cloudflare proxy. Happened ~12:03 UTC, request-id returned in client logs is rq_0a1b2c3d. Also seeing a billing spike (tokens double-counted?) during the same window. Can we get a repro and bundle?

violet: Sorry you're hitting this, keith. Can you paste the client-side raw curl you used (or a minimal repro) and the exact request-id? Also include the upstream proxy host if possible.

keith: request-id is rq_0a1b2c3d, upstream proxy = cf-proxy.example.com:3128. Client used node-fetch event stream but i reproduced locally with curl below. Getting 502 after a few chunks.

keith: ```
curl -v -N -x http://cf-proxy.example.com:3128 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-REDACTED" 
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" 
  -H "Connection: keep-alive" 
  "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/streams?model=redwood-alpha&prompt=hi"
```

violet: thanks. can you also attach the server-side trace id (x-request-id) if you saw one in our response headers? and the timestamp for the billing spike (approx). I'll start a debug bundle request.

keith: server header was X-Request-Id: rq_0a1b2c3d. Billing spike window ~2026-03-17T12:02:30Z - 12:05:00Z.

sre-bot: Incident record created: INC-2026-314. Collector link: https://internal.collector/INC-2026-314 - run `redwood collect-bundle --id rq_0a1b2c3d` and attach logs.

pranav: @violet @keith thanks. two hypotheses: 1) proxy returning 502 mid-stream causing client to retry, generating duplicate tokens; 2) our ingestion path counted partial chunk then retried leading to double-billing. Need a deterministic curl that reproduces the mid-stream 502 when routed via the proxy.

devex-ryan: I can help with a minimal curl that forces chunked streaming and shows the handshake/EOF. Try this exact repro (replace token and proxy):

devex-ryan: ```bash
# minimal streaming curl via proxy, show upstream headers and raw bytes
curl -v -N -x http://cf-proxy.example.com:3128 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-REDACTED" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Connection: keep-alive" \
  -H "X-Request-Id: rq_0a1b2c3d" \
  --no-buffer \
  "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/streams?model=redwood-alpha&prompt=test"
```

pranav: When you run that, please capture the curl stderr (for headers and timing) and the stdout (for streaming chunks). If you see `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` after some data, save both files. Also capture a tcpdump or pcap if you can.

violet: For validation on our side, please also run the same curl against our edge directly (bypass the proxy) so we can compare: `-x ''` or remove `-x`. If stream succeeds without 502 when bypassing proxy, that strongly implicates the proxy path.

keith: running now, will attach outputs shortly. If proxy is the issue, how do we avoid double-billing?

pranav: We need to correlate the ingestion logs: look for our internal ingest log lines with the same X-Request-Id. If we see two distinct ingest attempts for the same request-id with chargeable token counts, that's the double-count. We have a guard to de-duplicate on finalization, but partial-counts can still be tallied if client retries mid-stream.

violet: For the support bundle — please attach:
- curl stdout (stream chunks)
- curl stderr (verbose headers + timing)
- client logs showing retry/ reconnect attempts
- pcap or tcpdump if possible
- timestamped billing export slice (12:00-12:10 UTC)

keith: Attached curl.out, curl.err, and client.log (uploaded to INC-2026-314). tcpdump is a pain via customer infra, but i'll try.

devex-ryan: One more small test to help us reproduce: force an upstream 502 from the proxy using `--header "X-Force-502: 1"` (if customer proxy supports it) or a small payload that triggers their WAF. Also try adding `--http1.1` to ensure no HTTP/2 translation bugs.

keith: ok ran http1.1 and added header. got `HTTP/1.1 502` after 7 chunks. curl.err includes:

keith: ```
* Connected to cf-proxy.example.com (198.51.100.5) port 3128 (#0)
> GET /v1/streams?model=redwood-alpha&prompt=test HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood-inference.com
> Accept: text/event-stream
> Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-REDACTED
> X-Request-Id: rq_0a1b2c3d
> Connection: keep-alive
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< content-type: text/event-stream
< x-request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d
* Beginning data stream
< data: {"token":"hello"}
< data: {"token":"world"}
...
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
* Connection #0 to host cf-proxy.example.com left intact
```

pranav: perfect, that's actionable. I'll pull the ingest logs for rq_0a1b2c3d now and check for duplicate ingest attempts and token accounting.

violet: i'll link this bundle to billing and ask finance to freeze charge adjustments while we investigate (cc @finance). :lock:

sre-bot: Update INC-2026-314: engineer pranav assigned. Next update expected in 30m.

pranav: quick note — if we confirm proxy-induced mid-stream resets cause client retries, mitigation options: 1) client-side idempotent resume tokens (recommended), 2) server-side stronger finalization signals before billing, 3) guidance to customers to avoid midstream 502-generating proxies. We'll draft a KB entry after resolution.

keith: thanks all, attaching pcap as soon as customer allows. Appreciate the quick triage. :thumbsup:
